summary: Phase-2 (Reception console + Doctor consultation + Supabase auth exchange) verified. Backend suite `test_phase2_staff.py`: 14/18 pass, 4 fail — all four failures trace to the SAME critical bug: the second (and subsequent) walk-in for the same doctor on the same day 500s because /api/queue/walk-in always creates an Appointment with appointment_time='walk-in', which violates the partial-unique index `uq_appt_doctor_slot_live` (doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time WHERE status IN confirmed/in_progress/completed). Postgres asyncpg.UniqueViolationError bubbles up as a 500. First walk-in of the day works; every subsequent one fails. All other Phase-2 flows pass: staff/doctors (200 + 403 for patients), queue skip / complete / call-next (advance in_consultation->completed and mint next in_consultation), doctor/today (200 + 403 for patients), doctor/consultation GET/save/complete (with prescription + lab_orders persisted and visible to the patient via /prescriptions & /lab-tests), role security (patient 403 on staff+doctor endpoints; a different doctor gets 404 on another doctor's appointment_id), and /api/auth/supabase returns 401 on a bogus token. Frontend (mobile web 390x844): receptionist 9000000004 -> /reception with all Phase-2 testIDs present (call-next-button, add-walkin-fab, reception-logout, queue-row-*, skip-*, complete-*, walkin-name/walkin-phone/walkin-reason/walkin-submit, doctor chips recep-doc-*); Doctor 9000000003 -> /doctor with doctor-call-next visible; consultation screen has field-diagnosis, med-name-0, add-medicine, lab-CBC, save-draft, complete-consultation, consult-back. UI, navigation and login flow all behave correctly. No deprecated Expo packages, no red-screen errors. Console still emits the cosmetic RNW `shadow*` deprecation warnings noted in iteration_1.

critical.issue: Second (and every subsequent) walk-in for the same doctor on the same day returns 500. Root cause: Appointment is inserted with appointment_time='walk-in' (constant) but the table has a partial-unique index uq_appt_doctor_slot_live on (doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time) WHERE status IN ('confirmed','in_progress','completed'). Postgres raises UniqueViolationError -> uncaught -> 500. Reference: /app/backend/routes_queue.py:285 (appointment_time='walk-in') vs /app/backend/models.py:160-168 (partial-unique index). Fix options: (a) set appointment_time to a unique per-walk-in value that fits the String(10) column, e.g. f'w{tok}' (max 6 chars for tok<=99999), or (b) exclude source='walk_in' from the partial index predicate.

minor.issue: 500 responses currently leak SQL details to logs but return a generic Internal Server Error to the client — even after the fix, wrap Appointment insert in a try/except IntegrityError -> HTTP 409 with a friendly message so the reception app can surface it as 'Please try again' instead of a silent 500.

integration_issues.issue: When the walk-in backend 500s (bug above), the reception app catches the exception silently (submitWalkIn wraps setSaving in try/finally but there is no user-visible error toast). The user sees the modal close (actually the modal stays open because setModal(false) is inside the try and never runs) — but no error is shown. Recommend surfacing api errors via a toast/inline banner.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' twice on the login screen. Originates from the shadow() helper in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Non-blocking; already flagged in iteration_1.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix multi-walk-in-per-day 500. Simplest patch in /app/backend/routes_queue.py add_walk_in: set appointment_time to a unique short value like f'w{tok}' (fits String(10)) or f'wi-{tok}' (max 8 chars for tok<=99999), keeping source='walk_in' for reporting. Verify pytest test_phase2_staff.py::TestReceptionWalkIn passes after the change.

HIGH: Wrap the walk-in Appointment insert in try/except IntegrityError and return 409 with a friendly detail; then surface that in reception.tsx submitWalkIn as an inline error/toast (currently swallowed).

(Optional) In /app/backend/routes_staff.py::_get_owned_appt, differentiate 403 (doctor from another clinic) vs 404 (bad id). Current implementation returns 404 for both which is the safest choice, so this is a non-blocking note.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_queue.py:283-292 hard-codes appointment_time='walk-in' — this is the root cause of the walk-in unique-violation bug and should be a unique-per-token value.
reception.tsx submitWalkIn (line 52-61) has no error surface: any API failure is silently swallowed by the finally block; add an error banner on failure.

routes_staff.py complete_consultation is order-sensitive: session.add(MedicalRecord(...)) is added only if body.medicines is truthy; if the doctor completes with only lab_orders (no meds) no MedicalRecord is created. Consider always writing a record so the visit is discoverable in Records.

routes_queue.py websocket path is declared as '/api/ws' on a router with prefix='/api', producing the effective route '/api/api/ws'. Not tested (per note, WS is 403 via ingress and frontend uses polling) but this looks unintentional.
All Phase-2 files remain under 700 lines; async/await usage is consistent; testIDs are present on all interactive elements verified in the UI run.

rca_of_issue: REPRODUCE: curl -H 'Auth: <receptionist token>' -X POST $BASE/api/queue/walk-in -d '{"doctor_id":"<Meera>","patient_name":"A"}' twice. First call: 200. Second call today: 500. BACKTRACE (from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log): asyncpg.exceptions.UniqueViolationError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "uq_appt_doctor_slot_live" DETAIL: Key (doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time)=(doc_<meera>, 2026-08-23, walk-in) already exists. -> raised from /app/backend/routes_queue.py:288 await session.flush(). CAUSE: /app/backend/routes_queue.py:285 sets appointment_time='walk-in' for every walk-in, and /app/backend/models.py:160-168 declares a partial-unique index on (doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time) WHERE status IN ('confirmed','in_progress','completed') to prevent double booking. Every walk-in creates a row with status='confirmed' + the same (doctor, date, 'walk-in') tuple, colliding with itself. MITIGATION: In routes_queue.py::add_walk_in, replace `appointment_time='walk-in'` with `appointment_time=f'w{tok}'` (or any unique short value fitting String(10)); also wrap the flush in try/except IntegrityError -> raise HTTPException(409). This preserves the existing double-booking protection for online bookings (which use real HH:MM strings) while allowing arbitrarily many walk-ins per doctor per day.
